name: Big B
source:
An executive of the Red Floert Society. 
He does not participate in combat, but is in charge of supplying weapons and gadgets used by the Red Flower Society.
He is always looking for ways to make money, and will do anything prohibited by the organization in secret to make a profit.
He has a habit of jumping in at the first sign of a profitable deal, which often leads to painful consequences.
When he was about to get caught in a police sting operation while trying to trade bitcoin, Shawn and Yvet saved him, and he has been asking Shawn for advice ever since.
